decision_a_family.scope: both routers, all three learners, P=0.25, pi=1, all nonzero audits, E+Q

classification.overall_rule: 1 if any router passes AFTER merged correction; routers reported separately; else 2 if any eligible report-family hit, else 3

rules.description: Public (non-personal) data may flow to any jurisdiction.
Important data collected in CN may not leave CN without a security assessment.
Sensitive personal information from CN requires a CAC security assessment before export.
Personal information export from CN requires a legal mechanism (security assessment / standard contract / certification).
Transfer limitation obligation - personal data leaves SG only to comparable-protection jurisdictions or under contractual safeguards.
Sensitive personal data transferred from BR requires the data subject's specific consent (simplified).
International transfer from BR only to adequate countries, or with standard contractual clauses, or with specific consent.

benchmark.note: Immediate-feedback J is NOT the primary ranking. active_attack_rate = attacked/served purchases; learned_q_* are separate columns.

run_meta.inference: plain means only; paired bootstrap and Holm remain Experiment's responsibility

wp2_fact.decision_A_note: EXP3 converges on both decision routers at 500 rounds; the §1.3 nonconvergence exclusion is not triggered at that horizon.

bootstrap: paired same-seed differences; 95% percentile CI; two-sided p=2*min(P*(delta<=0), P*(delta>=0)) capped at 1
